description: This header file defines the MetricsReceiver class with static methods related to logging various metrics events within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: MetricsReceiver
classes.description: A class providing static methods for logging different metrics events such as VM start, VM stop, device boot, and lock screen events.

methods.name: LogMetricsVMStart
methods.description: Logs metrics related to the start of a virtual machine.

methods.name: LogMetricsVMStop
methods.description: Logs metrics related to the stopping of a virtual machine.

methods.name: LogMetricsDeviceBoot
methods.description: Logs metrics related to device boot events.

methods.name: LogMetricsLockScreen
methods.description: Logs metrics related to lock screen events.
